services.title: WordPress Development
services.description: Bespoke WordPress websites engineered for speed, security, and conversions — from custom themes to complex multi-site networks.
services.longDescription: Leverage the world's most powerful CMS with a custom architecture built for real business performance. I craft bespoke WordPress themes and plugins from the ground up — no bloated page builders, no copy-paste templates. Every project is optimized for Core Web Vitals, hardened for security, and structured to scale. Whether you need a high-end corporate site, a subscription platform, or a complex multi-site network, my WordPress solutions are engineered to grow with your business and dominate in search results.
features: Core Web Vitals Optimized (LCP, CLS, FID)

services.title: WooCommerce Stores
services.description: High-converting WooCommerce stores with optimized checkout flows, custom product systems, and seamless payment integrations.
services.longDescription: Sell more with a WooCommerce store engineered around conversion psychology. I build robust e-commerce environments that handle everything from simple storefronts to complex B2B catalogs with custom pricing, user roles, and automation. Every checkout is optimized to reduce abandonment, every product page designed to maximize trust and purchase intent. Includes full payment gateway integration, inventory automation, and a streamlined admin experience.

services.title: Elementor & Webflow Design
services.description: Pixel-perfect, brand-aligned websites built with Elementor Pro or Webflow — with clean code and no compromises on speed.
services.longDescription: Elementor Pro and Webflow are powerful tools in the right hands — and devastating when used poorly. I build with both, applying deep knowledge of their advanced capabilities while keeping code output clean and performance scores high. From custom-designed service pages to animated marketing sites, every deliverable is responsive, cross-browser tested, and fast-loading. No generic templates, no bloated widgets — just purposeful design that converts.
features: Custom Elementor Pro Widget & Template Design

services.title: Wix & Squarespace
services.description: Professional business websites on Wix & Squarespace — designed to look premium, load fast, and generate real leads.
services.longDescription: Not every business needs WordPress — and for many, Wix or Squarespace is the smartest choice. I build professional, high-end websites on both platforms that defy the 'template look' and stand out in any market. From local service businesses to professional portfolios and agency sites, I handle everything: custom design, content structure, SEO setup, contact forms, and ongoing training so you can manage it yourself with confidence.
features: Wix Studio Advanced Design & Velo (JS) Scripting

services.title: AI-Powered Websites
services.description: Next-generation websites supercharged with AI — from AI chatbots and dynamic content to automated workflows and smart lead capture.
services.longDescription: The websites that win in the next decade will be powered by AI. I integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities directly into your web presence — intelligent chatbots trained on your business data, AI-generated content workflows, smart lead qualification systems, and personalized user experiences. Whether you're embedding a custom GPT assistant, connecting to OpenAI APIs, or automating your entire content pipeline, I build the infrastructure that puts AI to work for your revenue goals.

services.title: Speed Optimization
services.description: Achieve 95+ PageSpeed scores on WordPress & any CMS. Faster sites rank higher, convert better, and retain more visitors.
services.longDescription: Every 100ms of latency costs you conversions. I provide deep technical speed optimization that goes far beyond installing a caching plugin. From image pipeline engineering and critical CSS extraction to database query optimization and server-side tuning, I move the needle on your Core Web Vitals scores to elite levels. I specialize in WordPress and WooCommerce speed work, and apply the same rigor to Webflow, Wix, and custom stacks.
features: Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) Deep Tuning

services.title: Technical SEO & Content
services.description: Technical SEO foundations baked into every build — structured data, semantic HTML, Yoast/RankMath setup, and content strategy.
services.longDescription: A beautiful website Google can't find is worthless. I build every project with a 'Technical SEO First' mentality, implementing the full stack of on-page and structural SEO from day one. This includes JSON-LD schema markup, semantic HTML5 architecture, crawl-optimized site structure, and proper meta strategy. I also set up Yoast SEO or RankMath with advanced configurations, create XML sitemaps, and build a content strategy framework so your site keeps climbing the rankings.
features: Content Pillar Strategy & Internal Linking Architecture

services.title: WordPress Care & Support
services.description: Ongoing WordPress maintenance, security monitoring, updates, backups, and priority support — so you never worry about your site.
services.longDescription: Your website is a living asset that needs consistent care to stay secure, fast, and up-to-date. My WordPress Care Plans provide proactive maintenance so you can focus on your business, not your website. I handle all core, theme, and plugin updates with pre-update backups, run weekly security scans, monitor uptime 24/7, and provide priority support for any issues. You get a dedicated partner who knows your site inside-out and keeps it running at peak performance month after month.

contactPage.headline: Let's Build Something

faqs.question: What is your typical project timeline?
faqs.answer: Most projects are completed within 1-3 weeks depending on complexity. I provide detailed timelines during our initial consultation.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes! I offer monthly maintenance packages to keep your website updated, secure, and performing at its best.

faqs.question: What technologies do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: I specialize in WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, React, Next.js, and modern web technologies. I choose the best tech stack based on your project's needs.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Simply fill out the contact form or send me an email. I'll schedule a free consultation call to discuss your project requirements.
